profile.name: Rupesh Nepal
profile.bio: Backend developer working across Python, Rust, and Go. Currently at Hyteno Tech maintaining backend systems for a European home furnishings retailer's 40,000+ product catalog across its webshop and marketplace integrations. Previously built the backend of a government project management system rolled out to municipalities across Nepal (Shangrila Informatics) and a C2C beats marketplace (Ascend Crest Technologies). GNOME Nepal open source contributor.
profile.summary: Backend developer with 3 years building production Django and DRF systems. Own data consistency across the database, Shopify webshops, and marketplaces for a 40,000+ product catalog; previously built a government project tracking platform for municipalities across Nepal. Strong in Celery, Redis, API integrations, and migrations.
profile.seoDescription: Backend developer specializing in Python, Rust and Go. Building scalable APIs, async systems, and open-source tools. GNOME Nepal contributor.

education.degree: B.Sc. Computer Science and Information Technology (CSIT)

experience.highlight: Syncs 10,000+ SKUs across marketplaces and led the ERP migration from a legacy SaaS e-commerce platform to an in-house Django ERP.
details: Built a daily self-healing sync of 40,000+ Shopify products into a central database, using bulk exports with a fallback to resumable multithreaded requests that checkpoint pagination cursors through rate limits.
Migrating marketplace sync for 10,000+ SKUs across major EU marketplaces from a third-party feed tool to direct API integrations in the in-house ERP.
Led the migration from a legacy SaaS e-commerce platform to an in-house Django and DRF ERP, moving all financial and warehouse data and eliminating recurring licensing costs.

Contributed to rebuilding product translation uploads for 10+ locales on Shopify's GraphQL API, matching translations by Shopify's content digests instead of 15 MB file imports, cutting a new-domain rollout from 2 days to 9 hours.
Helped replace a capped third-party bulk import tool with an in-house Shopify GraphQL pipeline that creates and updates products from a fixed-template file, 30-40% faster with no update cap.
Built monthly dynamic pricing compliant with the EU Omnibus Directive 30-day lowest-price rule.

Automated Google Shopping, Meta Catalog, and Pinterest Ads feeds through Google Sheets (OAuth, direct cell updates) and S3 (background processing), with rule-based product text, labels, and per-channel images.
Deployed and managed multiple production applications via Dokploy, reducing deployment overhead and improving operational visibility.

experience.highlight: Backend for a government project tracking system rolled out to municipalities across Nepal.
details: Built role-based Django and DRF APIs for a government project tracking system rolling out to municipalities across Nepal, hosted on-premise for confidentiality.
Built a unified Excel reporting module replacing inaccurate templates with reports that match each municipality's official standard.
Optimized the database queries behind project progress tracking and refactored the legacy codebase onto Django 4 with a clean, extensible structure.

experience.highlight: Built BeatzBazar, a C2C beats marketplace with SoX audio watermarking, Stripe payments, and real-time WebSockets.
details: As the sole backend developer, built the DRF backend for BeatzBazar, a C2C beats marketplace, with SoX audio watermarking every 10 seconds on previews so only buyers get the original file.
Integrated Stripe Checkout and webhooks for license tiers, using order IDs as idempotency keys to prevent duplicate charges.
Shipped real-time chat and notifications with Django Channels over WebSockets.
Ran audio processing and scheduled analytics on Celery, Redis, and Celery Beat, with a GitHub Actions CI pipeline (flake8, black).

experience.highlight: Maintainer of GNOME Nepal's Django backend and contributor to Djate. GNOME instructor, running Linux and open source sessions at colleges across Kathmandu.
details: Core contributor and maintainer of the GNOME Nepal backend system (Django).
Contributed to 'Djate', a production-ready Django project template used by the community.
Collaborated with open source contributors across Nepal to build and maintain community infrastructure.
Reviewed pull requests, triaged issues, and mentored new contributors to the Django ecosystem.
GNOME instructor, running Linux and open source sessions at colleges across Kathmandu.

experience.highlight: Ran operations for UbuCon Asia 2025 (400 attendees, 2 days, 30+ talks and workshops), leading a 20-member team, plus the social media campaign.
details: Led operations for UbuCon Asia 2025, hosted by Ubuntu Nepal: 400 attendees over 2 days with 30+ talks and workshops.
Led a 20-member operations team across the multi-day conference.
Ran the event's social media campaign.

experience.highlight: Led logistics for IdeaX 2023, a hackathon organized in collaboration with UNESCO.
details: Led logistics for IdeaX 2023, a hackathon organized in collaboration with UNESCO.
